+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Summarize recorded monitoring and authoritative per-process CT run costs."""
+from pathlib import Path
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def main():
+    mon=ROOT/'monitoring'
+    samples=0;first=last=None;minimum_free=None;maximum_rss_sum=0.
+    for line in (mon/'resources.jsonl').open():
+        try:row=json.loads(line)
+        except ValueError:continue  # A live writer may have an incomplete final line.
+        samples+=1
+        if first is None:first=row['utc']
+        last=row
+        free=row.get('available_memory_mb')
+        if isinstance(free,(int,float)):
+            minimum_free=free if minimum_free is None else min(minimum_free,free)
+        maximum_rss_sum=max(maximum_rss_sum,sum(p.get('rss_mb',0) for p in row.get('project_processes',[])))
+    runs=[];excluded=[]
+    for path in sorted((ROOT/'results').glob('ct*/runner_usage.json')):
+        r=json.loads(path.read_text())
+        times=[r.get(k) for k in ['user_seconds','system_seconds','wall_seconds_including_inputs']]
+        if r.get('gnu_time_resource_complete') is not True or not all(isinstance(v,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(v) and v>=0 for v in times):
+            excluded.append(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)));continue
+        runs.append(dict(case=path.parent.name,receipt=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),receipt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                         successful_execution=r.get('exit_code')==0,scientific_execution_gates_passed=r.get('scientific_gates_passed'),
+                         CPU_seconds=times[0]+times[1],wall_seconds=times[2],peak_RSS_KiB=r.get('maxrss_kb')))
+    token_file=mon/'token_snapshots.jsonl';token=None
+    for line in token_file.open():
+        try:token=json.loads(line)
+        except ValueError:continue
+    summary=dict(author='Codex-root',created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                 start=json.loads((mon/'start.json').read_text()),monitoring_samples=samples,
+                 first_sample_utc=first,last_sample_utc=last['utc'] if last else None,
+                 elapsed_project_seconds_at_last_sample=last.get('elapsed_s') if last else None,
+                 minimum_sampled_available_memory_MiB=minimum_free,
+                 maximum_sampled_matched_process_RSS_sum_MiB=maximum_rss_sum,
+                 CT_current_case_receipts=runs,CT_receipts_excluded_from_cost_sum=excluded,
+                 CT_CPU_seconds_including_recorded_failed_attempts=sum(r['CPU_seconds'] for r in runs),
+                 CT_CPU_seconds_successful_executions=sum(r['CPU_seconds'] for r in runs if r['successful_execution']),
+                 CT_sum_recorded_run_wall_seconds=sum(r['wall_seconds'] for r in runs),
+                 CT_largest_recorded_native_RSS_KiB=max((r['peak_RSS_KiB'] or 0 for r in runs),default=0),
+                 latest_tool_token_capture=token,
+                 historical_GL M_placeholder=None)
+    summary.pop('historical_GL M_placeholder')
+    historical=ROOT/'history/glm/monitoring/summary.json'
+    if historical.exists():
+        summary['historical_provisional_accounting']=dict(file=str(historical.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(historical.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),record=json.loads(historical.read_text()))
+    summary['counting_limits']=[
+        'CT costs use GNU-time per-process receipts, including retained failed current-case attempts. Unfinished jobs, archived prior attempts, pilots, builds and tests are excluded from this sum.',
+        'Historical pre-CT accounting is retained separately with its original scope; no complete all-project CPU total is asserted.',
+        'Summed concurrent run wall times are not elapsed project time. Sampled matched-process RSS sums may double count shared pages and miss between-poll peaks or short jobs.',
+        'Global free-memory and GPU samples include shared work. Native CT uses CPU only. Tool-reported goal tokens are not a provider billing audit; capture time and scope remain explicit.'
+    ]
+    out=mon/'summary.json';out.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps({k:summary[k] for k in ['last_sample_utc','elapsed_project_seconds_at_last_sample','CT_CPU_seconds_including_recorded_failed_attempts','CT_largest_recorded_native_RSS_KiB']},indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
